messages:
Ava Park: quick sync — launching the NexusCloud listing + integration this quarter. proposal: coordinated launch post, a short benchmark highlight (2 pages), and a joint 45-min webinar. want this packaged so sales and partner can use a single inbound funnel. who can own the funnel mapping?
Ravi Patel: I can map funnel with Sam. plan: webinar -> gated benchmark -> demo requests. we should add a short email nurture stream (3 sends).
Benji Cho: timeline check — marketplace listing goes live week of May 4. webinar ideally week after (May 11-15). is that still ok for partner?
Lena Morales: partner confirmed May 13 works for their execs. recommend 4pm PT to hit both NA and EMEA late morning.
Ava Park: great, lock May 13. webinar format: 20m benchmark takeaways + 15m live demo + 10m q&a. Benji can you own runbook and speaker list?
Benji Cho: yup. I'll draft runbook and speaker cadence. need a short benchmark narrative from research — can someone distill top 3 findings into bullets?
Ravi Patel: I'll extract bullets from the bench run. early draft: 1) 2-3x latency improvement at 99th pct under same cost profile, 2) 15-25% lower tokens/kg for long context, 3) graceful fallback to smaller variant for spikes. will refine w/ numbers.
Sam (growth): inbound routing: suggest webinar registrants go to a UTM'd hub page. convert to MQL if they request a demo or view >50% of benchmark report. routing: 1) MQL -> AE queue (partner-assisted), 2) SQL -> joint demo booking link, 3) nurture -> automated content drip.
Lena Morales: messaging iteration: we'll A/B test two lead magnets for the ad and email: (A) short benchmark summary vs (B) live demo invite. measure reg -> demo conversion after 2 weeks and pick winner.
Ava Park: approved. Benji, Ravi, Sam — owners: runbook, bench bullets, funnel + UTMs respectively. set deadlines?
Benji Cho: runbook draft by Mon Apr 22. will include: speaker roles, rehearsal schedule, slide deck outline, produce checklist, Slack alert templates, and fallback recording plan.
Ravi Patel: bench bullets and deck slides by Wed Apr 24. will attach raw CSV and visualizations.
Sam (growth): funnel mappings, UTM plan, and email nurture copy by Thu Apr 25. sample subject lines below:

```
Subject A: "How we cut inference latency in half — NexusCloud + Redwood"
Subject B: "See a live demo: faster, cheaper LLM inference with Redwood"
```

Lena Morales: I'll prep the marketing PR/launch post draft once I have the benchmark bullets — will also write an SEO-first headline and 2 social blurbs. aim to have draft by Fri Apr 26.
Ava Park: small ask — include a short single-slide one-liner for the listing page: "Redwood + NexusCloud: predictable, high-performance LLM inference across hosted & private deployments" — keep it simple for marketplace.
prod-bot: reminder: create calendar event after runbook confirmed; include recording permissions and partner calendar ACL.
Benji Cho: noted. next sync Thu 4pm PT for handoff review. I'll post runbook link and speaker roster in the thread. :thumbsup:
Ava Park: perfect. thanks team — let's keep the copy tight and the funnel measurable. we want a clear north star: demo requests / qualified pipeline from the joint campaign.
Sam (growth): adding checklist item: tag all leads with partner_source=NexusCloud and campaign=nc-integ-may to help partner success reporting.
Lena Morales: will also create two short social cards (static + 30s clip) for the post and webinar promos.
Ravi Patel: FYI — benchmark CSV will include runtime configs: model, batch size, quantization flags, region. that keeps the audit trail for claims.
Ava Park: awesome. if no blockers, I'll send a short brief to partner PM and legal for a quick signoff this afternoon. :rocket:
